$Comment: The trainer's daily: pay a tribute of life essence and take what the deep disciplines give back.
Repeat.Reset with Period Daily is a CALENDAR daily, not a rolling wait: the allowance refreshes
at the day boundary on server time, so a player who finishes late in the evening can go again
the next morning rather than waiting a fixed number of hours from whenever they last claimed.
Author AtMinutes on the Reset block to move the boundary off midnight.
It opens once the trainer has been met, and it is offered at the trainer only. The feature gate
keeps it out of the log entirely on a server with mastery switched off, where the trainer never
The whole payout is ONE Lootable reward, which is what makes the table worth reading rather than
the quest: Lootables/Mmo_Mastery_Offering.json holds four independent rolls, so a good day pays
several at once. Retune the odds there; nothing in this file needs to change to make the daily
more or less generous. The mastery-point roll is the one that matters for balance.
The tribute is essence and a little linen, both on Order 1 so they can be brought in any order,
and it asks for less than the temple guide's does: a player running both dailies pays nine
essence between them rather than the same toll twice. Linen scrap rather than something woven
keeps it inside what an ordinary afternoon turns up.
